title: Mar gaya tu jo
body:
haye akbar haye haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaya tu jo meri jaan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
kya isi din ke waaste beta
tujhko athara saal paala tha
yun na le mera imtehan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu na hoga to kaun bolega
mere haathon ko kaun kholega
jab satayengi rassiyan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaudvi shab ke maahtab ki maut
haye ye aalam e shabab ki maut
tujhko royega ek jahan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun na bichde kisi ka laal jawan
ye jo awaaz aa rahi hai yahan
hai teri maa ki siskiyan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao zindan hai bahot soona
waqt hai ye namaz ka beta
qaid khane mein do azan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere seene se khinch chuka naiza
aake mehdi mera nikalega
mere dil mein hai jo sina akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ne hashim bahot kiya israr
mat bichad jaan e syed e abraar
kya rahega mera yahan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
author: Hashim Raza
